entries.title: Participant inventory for sessions
entries.summary: set minimum and maximum participant targets per session and track staffing across the whole program with new **Assigned Participants** and **Assignment Status** columns on the Sessions grid. Off by default; enable it per event in Program Settings.

entries.title: Per-portal participant roles
entries.summary: limit which roles portal users can assign when they add a participant to a submission, configured per portal with **Selectable Participant Roles**. Portals without a filter keep offering every role.

entries.title: Portal sign-in methods per event
entries.summary: turn username & password, magic-link, and single sign-on (SSO) access on or off per event, including the new passwordless magic-link option.

entries.title: Date & time tiers for awards pricing
entries.summary: charge different submission fees by deadline, such as early-bird and late pricing, from the awards pricing settings.

entries.title: Grip and Bizzabo sync improvements
entries.summary: expanded guidance and behavior fixes for both connectors.
